project_type: TypeScript strict, Node 22, ESM; SQL Server 2025 + PostgreSQL 18 in Docker (docker-mssql-1, docker-postgres-1), already running; static site in web/
build_system: tsc to dist/ (npm run build); CLIs run from dist/ via npm scripts. Never rebuild dist/ while a harness process runs.
test_framework: vitest (npx vitest run); planted-defect checks via pwsh scripts/mutate-check.ps1 -File -Test -Mutants
test_command: npx vitest run; then npm run receipts:build and npm run site:check
verification_instructions: See plan.md in this folder: tasks 1-10 and the Digest. Batches: batches.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: receipts/ and the README status block are generated by npm run receipts:build (never edit by hand, never type counts). tests/<db>/ files are generated by agreed-tests/adversarial CLIs. evidence/adversarial/ is written only by the CLI.
environment_constraints: Never run two harness processes at once (convert, agreed-tests, adversarial run, run-all share scratch databases). The pwsh shell often hangs and returns only ^C while the command keeps running: one command per call, redirect to a NEW log file, check state before retrying; start long jobs in background and poll evidence/adversarial/status/batch-n.json. Commit locally with explicit paths; never push; no Co-Authored-By or Generated-with trailers. Agents and workflow steps NEVER run npm run approve or log-effort --review, and never record step 5.
contribution_requirements: Steering: verification-standard (six steps, never collapse), claims-and-evidence (wording: verified against the listed test cases; no guaranteed/100%), sources-and-data (public samples only), structure (one pair file per object; schema in src/pairs/schema.ts only; status rule in src/pairs/status.ts only), pair-records. Spec style: .kiro/specs/step2-coverage/{requirements,design,tasks}.md.
key_patterns: Spec-driven harness: ObjectSpec in src/conversions/specs*.ts, FixedCase in src/harness/generic/spec.ts; agreed tests generated by src/agreed/generate.ts and run by src/cli/agreed-tests.ts (capture from original T-SQL, tSQLt on SQL Server, plain SQL on PostgreSQL, FOR JSON = client re-run per ruling J1, planted-defect loop). CLIs read .env, write pair records with computeStatus.
directory_structure: src/{agreed,cli,conversions,harness,pairs,receipts,inventory}; pairs/<db>/*.json; conversions/<db>/*.sql (+ .draft.sql); tests/<db>/; evidence/; web/; scripts/; new: adversarial/<db>/, evidence/adversarial/, src/adversarial/
